conflicts.reason: Sony's February 2013 announcement printed 162 x 52 x 98 mm marked «(tentative, excludes largest projection)»; the August 2013 launch-colour release (CUH-ZCT1) and the current PS4 tech-spec page (CUH-ZCT2) both print 161 x 57 x 100 mm, so the shipped figure wins.

notes: One object for both DUALSHOCK 4 revisions: Sony prints the same envelope and mass for the launch CUH-ZCT1 (2013 colour-variation release) and the CUH-ZCT2 series (PS4 tech-spec page, en-au), so under the catalog's one-object-per-distinct-dimensions rule they share a key. Axes as Sony labels them: width x height x depth; «(excludes largest projection)» sets excludes_projections. Mass 210 g is confirmed by the CUH-ZCT2 instruction manual (playstation.com PDF, text extracted with PDFKit). Conflict: the February 2013 announcement's tentative 162 x 52 x 98 mm (pre-production) is recorded and not chosen. Control mapping (from the tech-spec page's «Keys / Switches» line, the complete list): Directional buttons = dpad 1; Action buttons Triangle/Circle/Cross/Square = face_button 4; L1/R1 = bumper 2; L2/R2 = trigger 2; left and right sticks = stick 2 (L3/R3 are their clicks); PS, SHARE, OPTIONS = button 3; the Touch Pad (with its click) = touchpad 1. Ports (the «Ports» line, complete): USB (Micro B) = micro_usb; Extension Port = expansion_slot; «Stereo Headset Jack» = headphone_3_5 (Sony does not print the diameter; the catalog's 3DS entry uses the same convention). wired=false: Bluetooth; USB is for charging and wired play. cell_count null for a built-in pack. Light bar, vibration, speaker and motion sensor have no contract kind. host_console uses the key sony-playstation-4-cuh-1000 (the launch model; any PS4 model hosts it) (align with the home-console lane's key). The CUH-ZCT2 light bar also shows through the touch pad; the shell difference is not in any Sony dimension.
